description: Component mole and total mass balance closure for all 33 configurations x 3 pressure cases
method: sum of product and tail flows minus feed, per species, relative

description: Sieverts flux hand calculation at 673.15 K, p_H2,ret 14 bar, permeate 1 bar, Pe0 4.57e-8, Ea 9.23 kJ/mol, 5.2 um
method: flux = Pe0 exp(-Ea/RT)/d * (p_ret^0.5 - p_perm^0.5), computed separately with R = 8.314462618

description: Recovery at very large area approaches the partial-pressure pinch limit y_H2 P_feed = P_perm
method: integrate with 1e6 m2 and compare with closed-form pinch

description: PSA published point reproduced when applied to the Aspen cracked gas: recovery 0.756 and purity (H2/(H2+N2), NH3 at 0.1 ppm) 0.9911
method: psa_split with Cho recovery and purity; this reproduces the input by construction, so it is a bookkeeping check, not validation of PSA physics

description: H2/N2 selectivity needed for N2 <= 300 ppm in the permeate at R = 0.90, 1 bar permeate, 400 degC, 20 bar baseline
method: bisection on ideal selectivity; compared with measured Pd-Ag purity 99.995 % (50 ppm total impurities) at 450 degC, 4.61 um (a membrane reactor, different feed)

description: Comparison with Cechetto 4 bar / 400 degC membrane reactor (X 99.3 %, R_H2 93.5 %)
method: not performed: that is a reactor result (reaction plus separation, vacuum permeate, lab module) and the library gives neither the module area nor Sieverts parameters of that membrane; a separator model cannot be compared with it

description: ISO 14687:2019 grade D limits transcribed (H2 index 99.97 %, total 300, H2O 5, N2 300, NH3 0.1 umol/mol)
method: values compared with the cited limits quoted in cechetto2023membrane p. 5 (NH3 0.1 ppm, N2 300 ppm)

description: Aspen baseline H2PROD stream (N2 0.0489 kmol/h, NH3 0) against grade D N2 limit: N2 ppm (Aspen stream)
method: N2 / (H2 + N2) from results/simulations/baseline.json H2PROD, compared with 300 umol/mol
